beats: A small stepped cluster of frosted-glass tiles in the middle of a bare page, lit from behind: light lives inside the tiles, and the ground between them stays unlit
Most tiles glow a pale, cool white tinted by the accent colours (ice blue, blue, lilac); one or two swell to pure white and fade back over about 1.2 s, as a light behind them drifts on its own

The pointer steers where the light sits: the lights behind follow a lagged copy of the pointer (25% of the way per frame, 95% of a jump in 174 ms), both by 20% of its offset (the reference's parallax; on a portrait page the share is scaled by width / height)
The tiles never move; only the light behind them does
